name: solana-anchor-devsecops-mcp
displayName: Solana Anchor DevSecOps, AST & GraphRAG MCP Plugin
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Solana Anchor DevSecOps IDE, integrating Extended Global Context (EGC) with secure AST analysis, contract generation, and manual-only GitHub PR deployment.

tools.name: generate_anchor_contract
tools.description: Generates production-ready, secure Rust/Anchor smart contract code with audited PDA derivations, checked arithmetic protection (checked_add/checked_sub), authority authorization guards (has_one = authority), exact byte memory sizing, and rent-exempt lamport calculations.

programName.description: Anchor program snake_case identifier (e.g. solana_sandbox_counter, slippay_escrow)

accountName.description: Anchor PascalCase PDA state account struct name (e.g. UserCounter, EscrowVault)

pdaPrefix.description: Deterministic seed prefix for PDA account derivation (e.g. counter, vault)

hasCheckedMath.description: Enforce checked arithmetic with custom error reverts on overflow/underflow

hasSignerCheck.description: Enforce Signer<'info> and has_one constraint for owner authorization

includeCloseInstruction.description: Generate safe close instruction with rent lamports refund to authority

tools.name: audit_rust_ast
tools.description: Performs deep static AST security analysis on Solana Anchor Rust code to detect missing signers, unconstrained accounts, arithmetic overflows, missing bump validations, and rent-exempt memory layout mismatches.

sourceCode.description: Rust/Anchor smart contract source code to analyze statically.

tools.name: create_github_pr
tools.displayName: Create GitHub Pull Request (Manual Merge Only)
tools.description: Creates and opens a Pull Request on a remote GitHub repository with the audited Anchor smart contract and DevSecOps CI workflow. Strictly enforces a manual-only merge policy (auto-merge disabled) and requires a valid GitHub Personal Access Token (PAT).

token.description: GitHub Personal Access Token (PAT, e.g. ghp_... or github_pat_...) with repo write permissions (Mandatory).

branchName.description: Git branch name for the Pull Request. Default is auto-generated devsecops branch.

contractCode.description: Optional Rust/Anchor contract code to include in PR documentation.

tools.name: run_property_fuzzer
tools.description: Generates and runs up to 20,000 property-based fuzz test vectors verifying Solana SVM invariants (checked math, signer spoofing, rent drainage).

vectorCount.description: Number of fuzz vectors to evaluate (e.g. 10000, max 20000)

hasSignerCheck.description: Whether signer check constraint is enforced

tools.name: derive_pda_spec
tools.description: Calculates deterministic PDA address, canonical bump, and verifies exact 49-byte rent-exempt lamport requirement.

tools.name: query_graphrag_security
tools.description: Queries GraphRAG cross-instruction dependency graph for Solana vulnerabilities and attack path reasoning.

attackVector.description: Attack vector to inspect (e.g. signer_spoofing, integer_overflow, rent_drainage)
